title: Fake Taxi QR
scenario: A taxi sticker QR asks you to prepay the ride before the driver starts.

answers.A: Use the official taxi app, meter, or verified terminal.
answers.B: Scan the sticker and prepay before checking the fare.
answers.C: Ask another passenger whether they have used that QR code.
answers.D: Ask the driver for the licensed payment method and a receipt.

explanation: A QR code can redirect payment without proving who receives it. Use the licensed taxi channel and keep a receipt.
proTip: A mystery QR code is not a VIP upgrade.
